title: 【时间囚笼03】冤个同事
slug: 回溯凶案现场全警局坐等我破案
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

孟长离上前拿起靠在门角的那根横木闩，将其中一端先放进卡槽里：“在能够借助外力的情况下，大家谁能有方法，让另一端也卡进去？”

王猛接过木闩的另一端打量：“我倒是有听说过，有些人能够只需要一根绳子，就能在外边直接把门给拴上，可惜我不会。难不成，凶手是个开锁匠？”

“你快别侮辱开锁匠了副队，用绳子拴门那法子我们村里头的三岁娃娃都会！”王建军不知道从哪里钻了出来，鼻孔里还塞着两坨纸团，闷声道：

“这木头长得滑滑溜溜的，只需要先卡住其中的一头，再拿根棉线或者细麻绳给另一头拴住，从底下门缝牵到门外去。人出去的时候把门带上，再在外头拉绳子。不仅能把门闩给卡上，绳子也能在外头回收了。”

孟长离和王猛对视了一眼，将手中的木闩递了过去，齐声道：

“那你来试试！”

“成，这法子我小时候为了偷跑出去玩可没少用，闭着眼睛都能给你们把门锁了。”

王建军跑到隔壁院子找人借了根棉线，照着方才他自己所说的方法给大家演示了一遍。

在好几双眼睛的注视下，木闩顺着棉线的力度，卡进了门后的卡槽里。

而棉线最后被王建军轻轻一抖再一拽，线头便自动脱落被他从门缝里拉了出去，木闩上没有留下任何痕迹。

众人：……好像真的不是很难啊，至少眼睛学会了。

等王建军再次迈入院子，就接收到了来自王猛探究的目光：“你小子最好从实招来，在四到五天之前，你人都在哪呢？”

王建军：……？

他没好气道：“我还能在哪？你在哪我就在哪！”

这问的难道不是废话么？

他俩平时就住在局里，还是在同一个宿舍，他要去哪里王猛还能不知道？

可王猛不听，王猛继续探究，王猛就是要围着他打转。

这都是王建军害他丢了一条调查线应得的报应。

看到跟前那犹如探照灯似的目光，孟长离唇角狠狠一抽。

她感觉王猛好像被这桩案子给逼疯了。

Page (1/3)

Meng Changli stepped forward and picked up the horizontal wooden bolt leaning against the corner of the door, and put one end into the slot first: "With the help of external force, can any of you have a way to get the other end to get stuck in?"

Wang Meng took the other end of the wooden bolt and looked at it: "I have heard that some people can lock the door directly from the outside with just a rope, but unfortunately I can't. Is it possible that the murderer is a locksmith?"

"Stop insulting the locksmith, Deputy. Even the three-year-old kid in our village knows how to tie the door with a rope!" Wang Jianjun came out from nowhere, with two pieces of paper stuffed in his nostrils, and said in a muffled voice:

"The wood is slippery. You only need to clamp one end first, then tie the other end with a cotton thread or a thin hemp rope, and lead it from the bottom crack to the outside. When people go out, close the door and pull the rope outside. Not only can the door latch be stuck, but the rope can also be recovered outside."

Meng Changli and Wang Meng looked at each other, handed over the wooden bolts in their hands, and said in unison:

"Then try it!"

"Okay, I used this method a lot when I was a kid to sneak out and play. I can even lock the door for you with my eyes closed."

Wang Jianjun ran to the yard next door to borrow a piece of cotton thread and demonstrated it to everyone according to the method he just said.

Under the gaze of several pairs of eyes, the wooden bolt followed the strength of the cotton thread and got stuck into the slot behind the door.

The cotton thread was finally shaken and tugged by Wang Jianjun, and the thread fell off automatically and he pulled it out from the crack of the door, leaving no trace on the wooden latch.

Everyone: ...It seems like it’s really not that difficult, at least my eyes can learn it.

When Wang Jianjun stepped into the courtyard again, he received a probing look from Wang Meng: "You'd better recruit from the facts. Where were you four to five days ago?"

Wang Jianjun:...?

He said angrily: "Where else can I be? Wherever you are, I will be!"

Isn’t this question nonsense?

The two of them usually live in the bureau or in the same dormitory. How can Wang Meng not know where he is going?

But Wang Meng didn't listen, Wang Meng continued to explore, and Wang Meng just wanted to circle around him.

This was the retribution Wang Jianjun deserved for causing him to lose an investigation line.

Seeing the gaze in front of him like a searchlight, Meng Changli's lips twitched fiercely.

She felt that Wang Meng was driven crazy by this case.
